The fare rules of the most restrictive flight are valid for cancellations and refund processes.

 
  

The flights on your ticket must be used in sequence. If you do not board any of the flights on your ticket, the remaining flights will be automatically canceled, including your return flights.

 
  

Refunds and changes are evaluated based on your ticket’s fare rules, usage status, and the specific segments being modified.

Refund before departure (unused ticket): For international flights, the most restrictive refund rule in the reservation applies. For Turkish domestic flights and flights between Türkiye and Ercan International Airport (ECN), the refund rules of each individual flight segment apply.

Refund after departure (partially used ticket): For international flights, the most restrictive refund rule applies, and the one-way fare of the flown segment is deducted from the refundable amount. For Turkish domestic flights and flights between Türkiye and Ercan International Airport (ECN), the refund rules of each individual flight segment apply.

Partial refund before departure (unused ticket): This request is processed as a change transaction; therefore, change rules and deductions apply. For international flights, the most restrictive change rule among the affected segments applies. For Turkish domestic flights and flights between Türkiye and Ercan International Airport (ECN), the fare rules of each individual segment apply.

Ticket changes: For international flights, if only the outbound flight is changed, the outbound fare rules apply. If only the return flight is changed, the return fare rules apply. If changes are requested for the entire ticket, the most restrictive change rule among the affected segments applies. For Turkish domestic flights and flights between Türkiye and Ercan International Airport (ECN), the fare rules of the segment being changed or of the entire ticket apply.

Flights in your reservation must be used in the order they appear.

 
  

If the cancellation or refund deduction fee is higher than the base fare of the ticket, the base fare and fuel surcharges (YR and, if applicable, YQ) are non-refundable. Fuel surcharges (YR and, if applicable, YQ) are also not refunded in cases where the ticket fare is non-refundable. Refundable taxes can be requested via the Manage booking page.

If you miss and do not use any flight, and choose not to take the remaining flights, you can view and process your refund and change rights via the manage booking page.

Any currency conversion differences that may occur during the payment process are independent of fare rules and are non-refundable.
